story.subtitle: Our Heritage
story.title: Our Story
story.heading: Afro Fashion: FAX Collections' Passionate Quest to Unravel Africa's Soul
story.p1: Our journey begins in the bustling city of Lagos, where the soul of Afro fashion pulses through vibrant patterns and colors. It's a place where artisans with paintbrushes in hand transform garments into canvases that share stories of resilience, pride, and a deep-rooted connection to the continent.
story.p2: Every piece in our collection is a testament to the rich tapestry of African culture — modern, bold, and unapologetically authentic.
